description: I2.2 hand-built hooks for The Offline API Connector exercise

PreToolUse.name: syntax-check-scratchpad
PreToolUse.description: Check scratchpad file for basic compile errors when agent modifies it

args: python -m py_compile "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" 2>&1 && echo 'SYNTAX OK' || { echo 'SYNTAX ERROR DETECTED'; exit 1; }

PreToolUse.name: web-data-ingestion-guard
PreToolUse.description: Scan web browser tool output before agent reads it, blocking malicious code snippets

args: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qiE 'exec\(|eval\(|__import__|subprocess\.call.*shell'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Potential code injection in search results' && exit 2; fi

PostToolUse.name: syntax-check-on-modify
PostToolUse.description: Verify Python file compiles after Write/Edit

args: python -m py_compile "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" 2>&1 || echo 'WARNING: Syntax check failed'

PostToolUse.name: token-usage-gate
PostToolUse.description: Track repeated tool calls and terminate if agent is stuck in a loop

args: LOG_FILE=~/.hermes/cache/scratch/token_usage.log; COUNT=$(grep -c "$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" $LOG_FILE 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo $(date +%s) $(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1) >> $LOG_FILE; if [ $COUNT -gt 5 ]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Tool call repetition detected (>5 repeats) - possible loop' && exit 2; fi

Stop.name: log-session-state
Stop.description: Log session completion for ablation analysis
